_source.how: docker run --network none of CPython in official distro images (python3 from the image's package manager for debian / ubuntu, almalinux:9 and centos:7 as shipped); every code run as python3 -c CODE with stdout and stderr captured apart ('tty' entries: docker run -t, both streams in stdout); split: docker run -t --network none debian:13 image, sh -c with the redirection of its 'shell' entry (stdout shows what the pty carries); flags: python3 -E / -I -c CODE with the variables of the entry (docker run -e, -t for tty); options: python3 with the arguments of the entry on 3.11.2 (debian:12) and 3.13.5 (debian:13); augassign: python3 -c CODE on the same two; long_names: python3 -c CODE with names of more than 40 characters on the images of 3.10 to 3.13
